optionalComponents.localLanguageModel: A separately licensed GGUF model and a compatible llama.cpp server build.
optionalComponents.broadcastStudio: An OBS Studio distribution with reviewed license notices; the local control adapter uses OBS WebSocket v5 on 127.0.0.1:4455
optionalComponents.speech: A local TTS engine and a separately licensed voice model. No voice model is bundled by default.
optionalComponents.mediaTools: A separately licensed FFmpeg distribution with its build configuration and notices reviewed.

capabilities.portableObsScenes: requires OBS portable files and portable media paths
capabilities.onlineBroadcast: requires a network connection and authorized platform account; public broadcast adapters are not yet implemented in the portable companion
capabilities.zoomMeeting: requires a network connection; OBS virtual camera or Zoom Video SDK integration
capabilities.automaticTiktokLiveChat: not enabled without an approved and documented integration
capabilities.localObsControl: Implemented as an optional authenticated loopback OBS WebSocket adapter; requires OBS Studio with WebSocket Server enabled and hardware verification
capabilities.onlineCompanion: requires authenticated Magnanimous account, deployed relay and Node.js 22+
capabilities.remoteCommandApproval: local approval required; OBS scene.set only is executable
capabilities.encryptedEventJournal: AES-256-GCM with a subkey derived from the unlocked workspace key; bounded to 8 MiB with atomic compaction
capabilities.eventRecovery: requires workspace unlock; locking clears in-memory queue and disconnects online bridge; legacy plaintext journal is migrated on successful unlock
